info.title: BankLite API
info.description: A clean architecture banking API using JWT authentication in HttpOnly cookies. Browser clients must send credentials with requests. Rate limits are applied per endpoint group: 30 req/min on account, transaction, user, and logout endpoints, 5 req/min login, 3 req/min register, 10 req/min chat and refresh, 5 req/min change password, and 3 req/min forgot/reset password.

post.description: Creates a new chequing or savings account for the authenticated user.

get.description: Returns all accounts belonging to the authenticated user.

post.description: Creates a new user account and returns a JWT access token via HttpOnly cookie.
Authenticates a user and returns a JWT access token via HttpOnly cookie.
Issues a new JWT access token using the HttpOnly refresh token cookie.
Sends a password reset email if the provided email exists in the system.
Resets the user's password using a valid reset token.
Revokes the refresh token and clears all auth cookies.
Sends a message to the AI assistant and returns a response. Max 200 characters.
Deposits funds into the specified account. Supports idempotency via Idempotency-Key header.
Withdraws funds from the specified account. Supports idempotency via Idempotency-Key header.
Transfers funds between two accounts belonging to the authenticated user. Supports idempotency via Idempotency-Key header.
Transfers funds to another user's account by account number. Supports idempotency via Idempotency-Key header.

get.description: Returns paginated transactions for the specified account. Optionally filter by type.
Returns all transactions for the specified account within a date range.
Returns the authenticated user's profile information.

delete.description: Permanently deletes the authenticated user's account and all associated data.
